verdict.rationale: Adyen explicitly documents generated reports for bookkeeping/reconciliation, webhooks for event-driven updates instead of polling, and per-balance-account/split-transaction data that supports per-seller and rolled-up views. However, evidence does not detail scheduled file delivery (SFTP/report scheduling), specific settlement report formats, or direct integration guidance for finance stacks like ERP/accounting systems. missing for 10: scheduled report delivery mechanics (SFTP/cron), report file format specifics, explicit finance-stack/ERP integration examples, independent verification of reconciliation report completeness.
